system.description:
• Effect: Shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than half your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below), choosing the form fresh each time (any beast in Monsters & Treasure, or one of these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Carrion Crawler, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Hydra, Piercer and Rust Monster; others at the GM's call, but never a solo, an intelligent or a magical creature).
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you choose to revert.
  • You take the form's whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, saves and movement.
  • You keep your own mind, personality and Wisdom-based abilities, and you cannot cast spells in a form that cannot speak.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

activities.name: Wild Shape
activities.text: Shapeshift into a beast of Level up to half your Druid level for up to 1 hour, taking its whole stat block.

activities.name: Wild Shape (Deepened)
activities.text: Shapeshift into a beast of Level up to your Druid level and gain temporary HP equal to twice your Druid level.
